main_text.p: CLEMENS Marotus Gallus magnā est adeptus gloriam ex eo tempore,quo primum poëfis gallica in precio haberi cœ-pit. Eius carmina,quamuis nitida & salsa, hac tēpestate exigua videntur, si eorum comparatio fiat cum his quæ scribuntur à quibusdam recentioribus Poëtis, quos omnes hic enumerare difficile esset: principem tamen eorum paulò post subiiciam. Hic Marotus Psalmos aliquot Gallico carmine reddidit, tran-stulit Metamorphosim Ouidianam, Eglogas Virgilij, Minois iudicium, Encomium Beraldi, & multa alia festiuitatis plena.

MAURICIUS Sceva Lugdunensis Poëta Gallus, longè omnium qui sua ætate floruerunt maxima doctrina & ingenij admirabili acumine celeberrimus, multa poëmata composuit & scripsit,quibus eius nominis fama nunquam sanè intercidet. Hic Dantis Poëtę Italici,longe difficillimi, animū prope gerēs, tam alto argumento, suam Deliam conscripsit, ut ab omnibus Poëtis nostræ ætatis,pro tanto tamque eximio opere,existimetur plurimum. Omnia is sua industria invenit,vir perspicacissi-mus,stemmata,trophæa,& imagines,quibus præclarissimus Henrici secundi,in urbem Lugdunēsem introitus, magna omnium civium concomitante lætitia & oratione,& magnificentissimo apparatu,fuit honoratus, anno 1544. composuit etiam librum inscriptum Microcosmos, id est parvus mundus, in cuius scriptis, quamuis elegantissimis, magis res, quam verba admirari debemus.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The two medallions are engraved portraits (left: laureate bust labelled CLEMENT MAROT.; right: bearded bust in fur collar labelled MAURITIUS SEVA. P.); the legends are transcribed above, with the medallion legend's "MAVRITIVS" read as MAURITIUS. Some letters in the medallion legends are worn and were read with some uncertainty. Uncertain readings in the text: "stemmata" (printed with a possible macron or spelling variant) and "animū" (macron on u) are as printed as far as legible. Printed spelling kept throughout, including "Sceua" in the running text, which was read as Sceva per the u/v rule; the printed form in the text is Sceua. The page shows minor show-through and a small mark near the left edge, which are not transcribed.
